architecture_binding.target_scope: deterministic recipient-scoped OFFERED/DELIVERED/UPTAKEN evidence plus exact matched intervention/control causal contract

source_surfaces.observed_mechanism: Production/stable Python property-based testing package; Python >=3.10; direct runtime dependencies are sortedcontainers plus exceptiongroup only below Python 3.11; build backend is maturin and the package includes a native module, so source builds can pull Rust/build cost even though runtime use can stay test-only.

RuleBasedStateMachine generates operation sequences whose available steps can depend on prior execution, checks invariants after steps, supports bounded stateful_step_count, and prints/minimizes a breaking operation sequence. This maps naturally to replay/stale-generation/order transition falsifiers rather than to canonical runtime logic.

Fixed @seed values reproduce the same generated test cases absent external nondeterminism; derandomize=True is intended for deterministic CI; database=None prevents mutable example-cache dependence; generated failures shrink; explicit @example cases are always run and are preferred when correctness requires a permanently pinned regression input.
Repository code is MPL-2.0 except explicitly noted third-party portions.

strongest_transfer: IDENTITY_NEAR_MISS_GENERATION: systematically mutate broadcast/selection/GRID10 plan id, generation and digest fields one dimension at a time and assert that no stale/mismatched case receives positive causal credit.

RECIPIENT_SCOPE_GENERATION: generate exact recipient subsets/supersets, missing receipts, duplicate receipts, unexpected recipients and UNKNOWN uptake states to validate completeness against broadcast.recipient_cell_ids rather than the full GRID10 universe.

MATCHED_PAIR_FALSIFICATION: generate intervention/control pairs with one controlled mismatch in probe id, non-broadcast input digest, intervention broadcast binding or downstream output digest and assert fail-closed behavior.

STATEFUL_REPLAY_FALSIFICATION: model OFFERED -> DELIVERED -> UPTAKEN -> CAUSAL_PAIR transitions plus reordered, replayed and stale-generation events; invariants should ensure no sequence can mint a positive result before all exact predicates are satisfied.
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SHRINKING: when a property fails, preserve the smallest generated failing tuple/sequence as a deterministic regression fixture, reducing diagnosis cost.
required_f2_fences: Hypothesis output is test input/evidence only, never canonical state, causal truth or runtime authority.
Use only in tests/CI; do not add Hypothesis to the Frankenstein production/runtime dependency surface.
Pin Hypothesis version/source identity for any evidence-bearing CI run.
Use deterministic settings for acceptance CI: explicit seed or derandomize=True, database=None, bounded max_examples/stateful_step_count; record the configuration in the receipt.
Promote any discovered minimal counterexample into an explicit fixed regression fixture/@example so future correctness does not depend on generator search luck.
Property-based test success cannot promote WP507 beyond repository-component test scope and grants zero GWT/J-Space/target-runtime/whole-system credit.

resource_assessment.source_build_caveat: maturin/Rust native build backend exists; prefer a pinned wheel in CI where available or account for build-tool overhead. No claim about wheel availability was promoted in this E1 audit.

counterhypotheses: WP507's hand-written fail-closed matrix may already cover all meaningful identity and matched-pair boundary cases; generated cases could add complexity without discovering new discriminators.
Property-based search may overproduce syntactic edge cases while contributing little to the scientific question of semantic uptake or mechanism-specific causal influence.
Mutable example databases, changing library versions, Python/hash nondeterminism or external state could weaken exact reproducibility if CI configuration is not explicitly fenced.
A smaller custom combinatorial generator may achieve equivalent coverage with fewer dependencies if WP507's state space is small and fully enumerable.

adjudication.next_discriminator: Under a separately claimed E2_ARCHITECTURE_MAPPED or E3_REPRODUCTION objective after WP507 source/tests are present on current main, implement a bounded deterministic property matrix around the real WP507 API. Compare against the existing hand-written suite using unique fail-closed boundary coverage and minimal counterexample yield. Reject Hypothesis if it finds no genuinely new invariant class and adds material CI/build overhead.
adjudication.proposed_acceptance_metric: At least one new reproducible minimized counterexample or a demonstrable new fail-closed invariant class beyond the existing fixed tests, at bounded CI cost; otherwise no promotion.
